traits: Cap 2 to 6 cm, bright to pale pink, with a small boss and a striate margin
Gills adnate or notched, pale pink to white
Stem very brittle, white with pink tints
safetyNote: Toxic: muscarine (the DGfM and Wikipedia, fr), with sweating, nausea and vomiting. Wikipedia (en) lists it as poisonous without naming a toxin. It is a close relative of Mycena sororia, separable only with the microscope (Wikipedia, en).
